comments.body: Landed on branch adevx-138-scope-checks-to-changed-paths at 5de869d, PR navapbc/agentic-development-platform#26 against v0.3.1. Plan review re-signed at the branch head with verdict PASS, 0 blocking, 0 advisory. Full suite 1559 passed, 19 skipped, 0 failed. All 10 new tests proven to fail without the source change.

compiled_state.description:
The checks gate runs a whole project test suite on every agent run, because the platform gives the declared command no way to know which paths the agent changed. For execution intake-f6f13c6b a pre-existing date-dependent failure in a test the agent never touched failed CI. The repair loop spent 105 LLM calls and 3.2M tokens trying to fix it, exhausted the budget, and parked the ticket in AWAITING_HUMAN with finished, correct work sitting on the branch.

The platform declares no build-tool convention, so it must not choose a test selector. It should instead tell the project which paths changed and let the declared command decide what to run. Thread the ticket file_impact paths from the workflow into the checks activity and the repair activity, and expose them to the declared command as a CHANGED_PATHS environment variable in both the checks pod and the fix pod.

Both ChecksSpec consumers must be threaded. The repair activity builds a ChecksSpec for run_fix, whose verify step re-runs the same declared command, so leaving it unthreaded would run the full suite during verification and reintroduce the defect.

CHANGED_PATHS holds the paths separated by newlines, exported as one shell quoted value so a path containing a space survives intact. A command that needs an argument vector converts those newlines to NUL with tr and pipes into xargs -0, rather than relying on bare word splitting.

This ticket adds the general capability only. Naming a specific repository is operator configuration, so the live entry stays in the untracked config/local/checks.yaml override and only the generic example-repo placeholder in config/local/checks.yaml.example is updated here.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] ChecksSpec accepts a changed_paths field, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_checks_runner.py -k spec_changed_paths`
- [x] The checks pod script exports CHANGED_PATHS when paths are given, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_checks_runner.py -k exports_changed_paths`
- [x] The checks pod script omits the export when no paths are given, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_checks_runner.py -k omits_changed_paths`
- [x] The exported value separates paths with newlines, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_checks_runner.py -k changed_paths_separator`
- [x] The exported value is shell quoted so a path containing a space survives, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_checks_runner.py -k changed_paths_quoting`
- [x] The fix pod script exports CHANGED_PATHS so the verify step stays scoped, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_checks_runner.py -k fix_exports_changed_paths`
- [x] The run_checks activity forwards RunChecksRequest.changed_paths into ChecksSpec, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_checks_runner.py -k forwards_changed_paths`
- [x] The apply_ci_repair activity forwards ApplyCIRepairRequest.changed_paths into ChecksSpec, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_checks_runner.py -k repair_forwards_changed_paths`
- [x] The draft pull request workflow forwards ticket file_impact into RunChecksRequest, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_draft_pull_request_workflow.py -k checks_changed_paths`
- [x] The draft pull request workflow forwards ticket file_impact into ApplyCIRepairRequest, proven by `pytest tests/unit/test_draft_pull_request_workflow.py -k repair_changed_paths`
- [x] The tracked example documents CHANGED_PATHS against the example-repo placeholder, checked: reading config/local/checks.yaml.example

## Testing
Run `pytest tests/unit/test_checks_runner.py tests/unit/test_draft_pull_request_workflow.py -q` to prove the threading and the export behaviour, then `ruff check .` for lint.
